expected: Transcript-based continuation retains required facts/tool results; replay allowed; no state-restore claim.
limitations: The first turn after a mid-generation engine death ended in an OMP-detected reasoning loop in 2 of 3 trials (explicit error, no false answer); a later turn recovered where tried. Idle-kill recalls passed in every trial.
Recovery is transcript replay with a full re-prefill, not engine-state restoration.
observed: One RPC-mode OMP client survived three interruptions in one session: the engine killed while idle (the next turn restarted it and recalled the tool-read nonce, 17.0 s wall including the reload and a cold re-prefill of 7,123 tokens), a client-side abort mid-generation (next turn recalled the nonce), and the engine killed mid-generation (the cut turn ended as an error, never as a completion; the next turn and a second turn both recalled the nonce, 16.2 s wall). The session id stayed the same; the file was rotated beforehand, so the answers came from the replayed transcript.

retry_history.reason: Idle-kill recall passed; after the mid-generation kill the next turn hit an OMP-detected reasoning loop (88-char cycle x12) and ended as an error.
Contaminated by the G14 stale-cancel defect (seed turn failed 'cancelled'); the post-mid-generation turn again hit a reasoning loop (6-char cycle x45).
Probe defect: the RPC client dropped an agent_end that arrived before the abort command's response; fixed with a regression test (tests/unit/test_rpc.py).
